page.content:
Unicorn, then alicorn, student of Celestia and leader of the Mane Six.

How Twilight Sparkle connects

  • Faction: Mane Six — Twilight Sparkle leads the Mane Six as Celestia's student and later a princess.
  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — Twilight Sparkle is the viewpoint pony of Friendship Is Magic.
  • Location: Ponyville — Twilight Sparkle moves to Ponyville to study friendship.
  • Character: Spike — Spike is Twilight Sparkle's assistant and letter-sending dragon.
  • Character: Princess Celestia — Celestia is Twilight Sparkle's teacher and later fellow princess.
  • Character: Starlight Glimmer — Starlight Glimmer becomes Twilight Sparkle's later student.

What is Twilight Sparkle?

Twilight Sparkle is the bookish unicorn Celestia sends to Ponyville, the leader of the Mane Six, and later a princess whose library and castle become the friendship school of Equestria.

Key threads lead to Mane Six, My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic, Ponyville, Spike, Princess Celestia and Starlight Glimmer.
